name: Tsukumo Ima
source:
Zodiac Sign: Gemini
Likes: Kako, His Dear Sister, "Sister Dearest"
Dislikes: Anything That Hurts His Dear Sister
Specialist Skill: Special Misconduct

"It's a crime that the word could possibly be used to describe anyone else. It should belong to her, and her alone!"

One of a set of twins — Ima is the elder by a few minutes. He acts like a carefree joker, but underneath that humor is a hint of something darker. A hardcore siscon, he thinks of nothing but protecting his sister. If anything or anyone dares to threaten [url=/c150706]Kako[/url]'s safety, Ima will show them no mercy.

[From [url=https://hundred-line.com/en/character/?p=ima]official site[/url]+in-game profile]
